candidate.digestAlgorithm: SHA-256 of sorted relative-path\0byte-size\0file-digest entries joined with LF; lockfile is raw byte SHA-256

environments.profile: Local no-cloud Mock profile; every database probe targets a disposable database created for this attempt.
environments.clockMode: Probe-controlled clocks for deadline cases; wall clock for local HTTP/browser checks.
environments.fixtureOrSeed: Disposable probe fixtures, per-probe cleanup and a per-attempt PostgreSQL database; no production/provider/payment requests.
environments.sanitationNotes: Command output is secret-redacted; test users, invitation tokens and signed URLs are omitted from evidence.

toolVersions.postgres: local server version captured by migration log

environments.effectiveLimits: Local PostgreSQL and Mock profile only; production email, real providers, Stripe and historical-balance recovery are deferred.

criterionResults.expected: New-user local sign-in, workspace, server quote, playable Mock output, history/credit lineage, private download, and restart persistence.
criterionResults.observed: The browser walkthrough file is accepted only if it records this exact candidate digest and all required journeys.

criterionResults.expected: Team creation, invitation/acceptance, removal, ownership transfer, workspace switching and personal-space restrictions work in UI and API.
criterionResults.observed: HTTP probes are run only against an isolated app/DB pair; viewport, keyboard and destructive owner-control UI evidence must also be current.

criterionResults.expected: Cancel/dispatch and terminal races have one outcome; replay and settlement have one effect; invalid output cannot succeed.
criterionResults.observed: The runner repeats the existing race probe on independently reset PostgreSQL fixtures. Callback twenty-replay evidence is not inferred from a race pass.

criterionResults.expected: Crash recovery at each local boundary, sweep/lease fencing, queue starvation and deadline races preserve invariants.
criterionResults.observed: Probe repetitions do not substitute for a process-stop/restart at every documented crash boundary.

criterionResults.expected: Unsafe MIME/size/path/media and cross-tenant/private downloads are denied deterministically.
criterionResults.observed: Asset path/media and workspace-scope assertions come from the local asset probe; generation-create rejects caller-supplied browser/provider URLs. Remote provider-output SSRF/redirect/DNS fixtures are deferred to task 5.7 because this no-cloud candidate has no remote-fetch path.

commonStandardResults.assertions: Frozen-lock install, production build, typecheck, lint, format and strict OpenSpec validation.
Declared source/schema/config/contract/validator/lock digests are unchanged across the verification attempt.
At least 80% aggregate branch coverage across 37 owned modules, with all sources present in LCOV.
Disposable local PostgreSQL probes pass; HTTP/browser integration remains blocked until an isolated candidate app is hosted.
Current-candidate UI success/loading/empty/error/denied state review at 1440x900 and 390x844 plus keyboard traversal.

Critical selected generation create and race probes repeat three times; twentyfold callback replay, conflicting payload/reorder, ten-attempt financial races, and every crash-boundary restart remain separate mandatory evidence.
A different verifier/product reviewer and an integrator must decide after all mandatory evidence exists.
